lines: Mind the tannery. What do you need?
Set your feet somewhere dry and tell me what brought you in.
I have thread on my fingers, but I can listen.
Careful of the bucket by the door. Now, what is it?
You caught me between two saddles. Good timing.
Come in before the smell changes your mind.
Give me a moment to put this knife down.
If you need a repair, show me where it failed.
Morning. I have just opened the dye vats.
There you are. I thought I heard boots outside.
Do not touch the hides on the left. The rest of the room is safe enough.
I can spare a few minutes while that coat dries.
Hello again. How is the road treating your gear?
Was it me you needed, or are you looking for the smith?
Pull up that stool if you plan to stay awhile.
You arrived before the next customer. What is on your mind?
Mind the straps across the floor. I am sorting an order.
I was about to make tea. You can talk while it heats.
That pack sounds loose from here. What else is troubling you?
Welcome. Let me finish this stitch, then I am yours.
